answer.rationale: Use referral incentives for established SMB customers rather than matching the competitor with promotional pricing. Referrals previously added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm, while targeted discounts delivered acquisition lift but reduced 30-day retention by 12% and were explicitly deemed unsustainable. Run a standard, retention-guarded rollout targeted to established accounts; this does not prove it will neutralize price-driven churn, so monitor SMB retention and qualified referred revenue closely.
